title: Add beta sign-up form for Westbrook students
text:
## Goal

Let Westbrook University students sign up for the Pairly beta before the Nov 2 launch.

## Form fields

- University email (must end in the Westbrook domain)
- Major
- Phone type (Android or iOS), so we know which store link to send

## After sign-up

- Show "You're on the list! We'll email you on November 2."
- Add the student to the beta tester list that Wop manages

Owner: Wop testwell. Tomas Rivera will share the link with campus clubs.
